important_factors: Current usable inventory of 380 units will stock out on 2026-09-27 without action, leading to 600 unmet demand units over 28 days.
Placing a PO for 800 units with SUP-A delivers on 2026-09-24 (7-day lead time), completely eliminating unmet demand.
Order cost of $9,600.00 is within the available budget of $20,000.00 and volume fits within available warehouse storage.
Order cost exceeds autonomy limit ($2,000.00), requiring buyer approval.
args.rationale: The recommended purchase of 800 units is correct and should be executed. Current usable inventory is 380 units against a forecast demand of 980 units (35 units/day over 28 days). Without intervention, stockout occurs on 2026-09-27 with total unmet demand reaching 600 units. Placing an order for 800 units with SUP-A at $12.00/unit ($9,600.00 total) with a 7-day lead time yields an expected receipt date of 2026-09-24, preventing stockout and meeting all demand. Closing inventory at horizon end will be 200 units (5.7 days of cover), satisfying safety stock requirements and remaining well within the 12-day excess cover policy limit (420 units). Available budget ($20,000.00) and warehouse storage capacity (headroom 180 m³) fully support this order. Because total spend ($9,600.00) exceeds the autonomy limit of $2,000.00, buyer approval is required.
assumptions: Demand forecast of 35 units/day over 28 days remains valid for planning purposes.
